label: Save paper summary version
description: Save one completed, self-reviewed, citation-grounded single-paper summary as a new immutable version and update the paper's canonical summary.md. Use this exactly once after reading the paper and checking evidence, whether the summary came from chat or the dedicated paper-summary workflow.

parameter_descriptions.document_id: The exact local document ID being summarized.
parameter_descriptions.content: The complete final summary Markdown with valid paper page or chunk citations.
parameter_descriptions.review_summary: A concise record of the reviewer checks completed and any remaining evidence limitations.
